findings: Document upload route still imported validateUploadFileSignature instead of validateUploadFileSecurity, so dangerous filenames, unsupported filename extensions, extension/content mismatches, and MIME spoofing checks could be bypassed before storage.
The central upload security helper already performs the stronger validation, so changing the route to call it is a non-breaking hardening correction.
vercel.json remains limited to one daily internal maintenance cron and keeps npm install --ignore-scripts plus npm run build.
No new billing/demo entitlement exposure was confirmed in the inspected files during this run.
actions_taken: Updated src/app/api/documents/upload/route.ts to call validateUploadFileSecurity before malware scanning and storage.
Recorded this audit action in a supplemental agent log because replacing the long root agent_log.json safely was not practical through the truncated connector view in this run.
